# LBA fixtures

All four files are **shaped from the documented route contract**, not recorded
captures: the probe that established the field names ran outside this
repository on 2026-11-22 and no first-party body was retained.

- `championships_2026.json` — competition list for season key 2026 (first year),
  with one Serie A regular-season row plus an unrelated cup.
- `calendar_602.json` — three focus-day rows: two finished (explicit `+01:00`
  offset) and one scheduled.
- `pbp_25426.json` — reverse-chronological actions whose period ends are
  cumulative 22-20, 48-50, 72-72, 100-86, i.e. quarters 22-20 / 26-30 / 24-22 /
  28-14.
- `pbp_noncontiguous_ot.json` — regulation anchors plus a lone period 6, used to
  prove non-contiguous overtime is refused.
